description: This Java source file contains integration tests (endpoints checks) for a banking application's REST API, using JUnit 5 and Spring Boot testing framework. It performs HTTP requests to specific endpoints to verify responses, including health checks, API documentation, Swagger UI, and H2 console accessibility.

classes.name: EndpointChecksIT
classes.description: A test class for performing HTTP-based integration checks on various application endpoints, ensuring they are accessible and returning expected content and status codes.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for tests, considering environment variable OVERRIDE and default value, ensuring no trailing slash.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a specified path or full URL, with optional Accept header, returning the response.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Determines if a status code indicates an HTTP redirect.

methods.name: followRedirectOnce
methods.description: Follows a single redirect response, asserting presence of Location header, and returns the subsequent response.

methods.name: healthzReturnsOkJson
methods.description: Test that /healthz endpoint returns HTTP 200 with JSON containing 'status':'ok'.

methods.name: actuatorHealthReportsUpStatus
methods.description: Test that /actuator/health endpoint reports status UP.

methods.name: openApiDocsContainOpenApiFieldOrSkipIfSwagger2
methods.description: Verifies presence of 'openapi' field in API docs, or skips if Swagger 2.x.

methods.name: swaggerUiIsReachable
methods.description: Checks that Swagger UI endpoint is reachable and contains 'Swagger UI' text.

methods.name: h2ConsoleIsReachable
methods.description: Checks that H2 console endpoint is reachable and contains 'H2 Console' text.
